entries.title: Wi-Fi icon blinking or still (QD line)
steps: The Wi-Fi icon blinks when the terminal is not connected.
It stays still when connected successfully.
The battery icon shows the charge level.

entries.title: Wi-Fi icon keeps blinking (QD line)
steps: A blinking Wi-Fi icon means the terminal is not connected to Wi-Fi.
Reconnect to the network; the icon stops blinking once it is connected.

entries.title: Power off or reboot a QD terminal
steps: Press and hold the button on the side of the terminal until a menu appears.
The menu offers Power Off, Reboot, Airplane Mode and Silent Mode.
Tap the option you want.

entries.title: Power cycle (reboot) a Z8
steps: Press and hold the power key on the keyboard.
Release it once the terminal starts to reboot.

entries.title: Wi-Fi icon blinking or still (Z8)
steps: The Wi-Fi icon blinks when the terminal is not connected.
It stays still when connected successfully.

entries.title: Turn a Z9 on and off
steps: To power on, press the power key.
To power off, tap the icon for the Services menu, then tap Power Off.
entries.note: Xplor Pay's copy of this guide says to reach Power Off from the Favorites (star) menu instead.

entries.title: Power cycle (reboot) a Z9 or Z11
steps: Press and hold the power key on the keyboard.
Release it once the terminal starts to reboot.

entries.title: Status icons on a Z9 or Z11
steps: Wi-Fi icon: blinks when not connected, stays still when connected.
On mobile units, the GPRS signal strength indicator shows more bars for a better signal.
A battery strength indicator shows on mobile units.
A separate icon indicates an issue with the SIM card (GPRS).

entries.title: Icon shows an issue with the SIM card (GPRS)
steps: The terminal is reporting a problem with its SIM card.
Contact support about the SIM and its cellular service.

entries.title: How the Z8 idle screen works
steps: When idle the Z8 shows Credit and Sale.
Press the back key until the transaction type you want appears.
Use the up and down arrow keys to change payment type.
The F1 key opens the Services menu.

entries.title: Turn On/Off
steps: Power On: Press and hold down the power key until your Dejavoo Z6 is activated.
Power Off: Press down the power key on your Dejavoo Z6 until the device powers off.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal.

entries.title: Set Up an Ethernet: Connect to Ethernet
steps: To get started, click on the wireless icon in the corner of your Z6 touchscreen (located next to the DATE AND TIME).
Select ETHERNET.
Ensure that the Ethernet radio button on your screen is turned on.
When prompted, press CONNECT.
At this point, your Z6 should verify that your Ethernet is connecting to an IP address. Your Dejavoo Z6 is now connected via Ethernet.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal.

entries.title: Process a Sale: Chip Credit Sale
steps: Select CREDIT.
Select SALE from your menu’s home screen.
Enter SALE AMOUNT.
Press OK to confirm.
The cardholder will be asked to tap, swipe, insert the card, or enter the card details manually to authenticate payment. Cardholders insert their EMV chip card or exercise the contactless tap option.
Remove card when prompted.
The transaction will either be approved or declined. The cardholder may be asked to sign for the purchase.
The merchant has the option to send the cardholder a sales receipt via email or text or by printing using an existing POS receipt printer.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal.

entries.title: Process a Sale: Manual Entry Credit Sale
steps: Select CREDIT.
Select SALE from your menu’s home screen.
When prompted, enter SALE AMOUNT.
Press OK to confirm.
The cardholder will be asked to tap, swipe, insert the card, or enter the card details manually to authenticate payment. Select ENTER CARD #.
The merchant will manually enter the number of the card used in the transaction. You will also be asked to enter the expiration date and possibly the billing zip code and CID.*
The transaction will either be approved or declined.
The merchant will have the option to send the cardholder a receipt for their sale via email or text or by printing using an existing POS receipt printer.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal.

entries.title: Process a Sale: Debit Sale
steps: Select DEBIT.
Select SALE from your menu’s home screen.
Enter SALE AMOUNT.
Press OK to confirm.
The cardholder will be asked to tap, swipe, insert the card, or enter the card details manually in order to authenticate payment. When prompted, select the relevant application and payment method.
Customers will be prompted to enter PIN details on the Z6 PIN pad before finalizing their purchase.
The merchant will then have the option to send the cardholder a receipt for their sale via email or text or by printing using an existing POS receipt printer.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal.

entries.title: Process a Sale: Cash Sale
steps: Select CASH.*
Select SALE from your menu’s home screen.
Enter SALE AMOUNT.
Press OK to confirm.
The merchant will then have the option to send the cardholder a receipt for their sale via email or text or by printing using an existing POS receipt printer.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal.

entries.title: Do a Factory Reset
steps: Start by accessing the MENU on your Z6, i.e. the three horizontal bars on the bottom half of your screen.
Select UTILITY.
Select SOFTWARE DOWNLOAD.
Select DELETE APPS.
Manually select the apps you wish to delete.
At this point, the terminal will start to reboot.
If necessary, repeat steps 1-7.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's. It describes the Z6 as a touch-screen device that runs sales itself; our sheet treats the Z6 as a non-touch PIN pad working off a master terminal. The guide warns a factory reset erases all data, including transaction history and settings.

entries.title: Load and Change Paper Roll
steps: Open the terminal’s top paper compartment.
Insert the correct Dejavoo Z8 paper roll size, ensuring the paper feeds from the bottom.
Extend a few inches of paper from the top of the roll.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's.

entries.title: Turn On/Off: Power Off
steps: Press and hold the POWER BUTTON located on the side or back of the device.
Confirm power off: Hold the POWER BUTTON until asked to confirm that you want to turn it off.
Release the POWER BUTTON once the screen goes dark. The device is powered off.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's.

entries.title: Set Up an Ethernet or Wifi Connection: Connect to Ethernet
steps: Verify that the Dejavoo Z8 is not connecting to Wifi and that the Ethernet cable is plugged into an available port on the back of your device.
Hit the GREEN KEY to prompt the core menu from the main menu.
Select the UTILITY option.
Choose the COMMUNICATIONS option.
Select LOCAL PATTERNS.
Pick the ETHERNET option.
Mode Feature: PRESS the GREEN button to select OK.
Static IP Feature: Choose STATIC and PRESS the green button to confirm.
You will be asked if you want to change Ethernet mode from DHCP to Static. For DHCP, PRESS F2 to confirm. For Static, scroll down and select STATIC.
Press F2 for YES.
Click OK to confirm your option.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's.

entries.title: Set Up an Ethernet or Wifi Connection: Connect to WiFi
steps: At the main menu, press the GREEN BUTTON to access the core menu.
Find and select the UTILITY option.
Enter the Dejavoo Z8 manager password when prompted.
Below the UTILITY option, click COMMUNICATIONS.
Choose LOCAL PARAMS.
Select WIFI.
Find your local network.
Select CONFIGURE.

After entering the local network password, confirm by pressing the GREEN BUTTON. Per the Dejavoo Z line handbook, merchants are discouraged from using special characters in composing their network password.
Press the yellow button, then select CONNECT.
To confirm, press F2.
Note: The IP address should not display with zeros and show as connected. For those connecting via Ethernet, be sure there is a LAN cable connected to the LAN port on your DejaVoo Z8.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's.

entries.title: Enable/Disable Card Types
steps: Select APPLICATIONS from the home screen.
If asked, enter the Dejavoo Z8 default/manager password.
Press OK on CREDIT/DEBIT/EBT.
Press SET UP.
Press CARD TYPES.
Scroll down to desired card removal.
Choose either On/Off to Enable/Disable.
Card type has been Activated/Deactivated.
entries.note: From PaymentCloud's own guide, not Dejavoo's.

PROCESS the card by tapping, swiping, or inserting.

The transaction is processed. Receipts will print with sale details.

The transaction has been processed, and detailed sales receipts will print automatically.

Press the yellow key with the arrow pointing to the left.
Scroll up to the TICKET option. Press OK to confirm.
After entering the total amount of the sale again, press OK.
Enter the default password, then press OK to proceed.
Enter AUTH CODE.
Swipe, tap, insert, or manually enter card number details. If prompted, include AVS information.
Press OK to confirm.
Note: Restaurant sales authorized via the Dejavoo Z8 with Aura may ask merchants to enter the server ID before making sales.

entries.title: Reprint Receipts
steps: In the main menu, press F1 to access the SERVICES menu.
Using the arrow keys, highlight FAVORITES and press OK to confirm.
Using the arrow keys, highlight REPRINT CR/DB RECEIPT and press OK to confirm.
Enter the manager password when prompted.
Highlight desired options (LAST, BY TRANSACTION NUMBER, or BY CARD NUMBER) and press OK.
Allow the transaction receipt to print.

entries.title: Print a Presale Ticket
steps: Presale tickets allow merchants to add tips for customers at restaurants.
Press F3 to access the terminal Favorites Menu, or tap the STAR icons on the bottom of the display screen.
Select PRESALE TICKET and press OK to confirm.
Hit sale amount and press OK to confirm.
The ticket will print shortly after. Customers should complete the presale ticket and return it to the cashier with payment.
Note: Adjusting print options to 0 allows some Dejavoo models to operate in No Paper Mode.
